metadata.description: Welcome to "What's that Sound," the ultimate audio guessing game for kids! your kids will put their listening skills to the test as they work to identify a variety of different noises. they will have 10 seconds to guess the noise before the answer is revealed. Get ready for an exciting guessing adventure!
